calendar_environment.interpretation: Child-process computational calendar control only. Physical lighting/weather timezone inputs unchanged. Uncontrolled host-DST Windows arrays can differ near month edges; old frozen profiles/annual targets unchanged.

comparison_policy.canonical_resource_encoding: UTF-8 LF sorted JSON keys; strict finite JSON; SHA-256 immutable bytes

continuous_receipt_policy.exact: Source evidence/operands, states, draws, option selection, event start/length and discrete source decisions
continuous_receipt_policy.fractions: Generated fractional daily profiles and fixture component integrals
continuous_receipt_policy.source_arithmetic: Generated hours-of-operation/daily point abscissae and native minute powers/flows; exact event timing, source inputs and RNG draws are excluded

exported_reference_precision.resstock_profile: three significant digits; quantization interval plus raw tolerance

comparison_policy.numerical_bundle_identity: Source/numerical equivalence; no floating-array SHA equality requirement

capture_provenance.interpretation_note: Actual native full-year event methods before budget binding in controlled-no-DST environment. Six exact frozen configuration inputs plus explicit component/presence probes. Controlled component traces replace only returned one-hot states after genuine activity draws; no-event normalization is undefined upstream and is explicitly rejected by Python. EV output excluded with native allocator slot retained. Calibration never substitutes annual magnitudes.
capture_provenance.original_unit: minute-indexed calibration draws; dimensionless hourly fractions; native random draws
capture_provenance.original_value: Independent upstream full-year traces and raw continuous channels retained
